<E800 893><E563><E800 896><E147 66 64><E800 897><E124 66 1><E800 898><E130 26 1><E800 899><E131><E800 901><E164 66 67 1 2 6 0 0 1><E800 902><E139 66><E800 904><E615 52><E800 906><E041 66 52><E025 2>The only thing troubling me<E003 6> is that little Japanese lodger

<E800 917><E563><E800 921><E147 66 64><E800 922><E124 66 1><E800 923><E131><E800 926><E164 66 67 1 2 7 0 0 1><E800 927><E139 66><E800 929><E615 52><E800 930><E041 66 52><E025 2>The point is, <E003 8>it's very difficult to know what would make

<E800 1524><E563><E800 1527><E147 9 0><E800 1528><E130 29 1><E800 1529><E131><E800 1531><E564 2><E800 1532><E041 9 2><E025 2>It's very important to listen carefully to every juror,<E003 4>

<E800 1535><E563><E001>

<RDFG 909><E800 1545><E637 1 2><E800 1546><E640><E800 1550><E564 2><E800 1551><E041 3 2><E025 2>Let me see...<E003 8> It's a book entitled<E003 4> ‘The Lion's Pride’.<E023><PAGE>
<E800 1552><E041 1 0><E025 2>I'm afraid I don't know any English literature at all.<E023><PAGE>
<E800 1553><E041 1 0><E025 2>So it wouldn't be something I've heard–<E023><PAGE>
<E800 1554><E041 1 0><E330><E025 2>Wait a minute!<E023><PAGE>
<E800 1555><E041 1 0><E025 2>‘The Lion's Pride’?<E003 14>
<E025 3><E007>(That's strange...)<E023><PAGE>
<E800 1556><E041 1 0><E025 3><E007>(...I think I have heard of a book by that name before.<E003 12>
<E025 2>And very recently, too.)<E023><PAGE>
<E800 1557><E041 3 2><E025 2>It's a title I recognise too,<E003 4> Mr Naruhodo.<E023><PAGE>
<E800 1558><E563><E800 1560><E638><E800 1561><E640><E001>

un seul ouvrage britannique<E025 7>...<E025 2><E023><PAGE>
<E800 1553><E041 1 0><E025 3>Alors, évidemment, <E003 8>je n'ai jamais entendu
ce "titre"<E003 4> de toute ma vie<E025 7>.........<E025 3><E023><PAGE>
<E800 1554><E041 1 0><E330><E025 3>Hm, attends un peu.<E023><PAGE>

<E800 1557><E041 3 2><E025 3>Pour être franche, <E003 8>j'éprouve moi aussi<E025 7>...<E025 2> <E003 8>

<E800 1558><E563><E800 1560><E638><E800 1561><E640><E001>

<RDFG 917><E800 1567><E637 1 2><E800 1568><E640><E800 1573><E564 2><E800 1574><E041 3 2><E334><E025 2>Oh!<E003 14> <E025 1><E338><E341>Look at this!<E003 14>
<E025 2>The book has been badly burnt!<E023><PAGE>
<E800 1575><E041 1 0><E341><E025 2>You're right.<E003 10> You'd never be able to read it in this state.<E003 10>
Especially not the latter pages.<E023><PAGE>
<E800 1576><E041 3 2><E025 2>What a terrible waste...<E023><PAGE>
<E800 1577><E041 3 2><E025 2>Judging from the scorched edges of the paper,<E003 8> I think the
damage must have occurred very recently.<E023><PAGE>
<E800 1578><E041 1 0><E025 3>Hm...<E003 12>a book...<E003 8>recently damaged by fire...<E003 10>
<E025 2><E007>(Why does that seem to raise a red flag with me?)<E023><PAGE>
<E001>

<RDFG 917><E800 1567><E637 1 2><E800 1568><E640><E564 2><E800 1573><E041 3 2><E334><E025 2>Ouh là ! <E003 8><E025 3>Re-<E025 7>...<E025 2> <E003 8><E025 2><E338><E341>Regardez, là !<E003 8>
